metadata.scenario: A new customer calls to schedule their first consultation for physical therapy next week. Category: Appointment Scheduling. Outcome: appointment_booked.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret. How can I assist you today? Hi Margaret, this is Agnes Rodriguez. I’d like to schedule a physical therapy consultation for next week. Hi Agnes! It's great to hear from you. We can definitely help with that. What day are you looking at? I was thinking maybe Wednesday. Does that work? Let me check our availability for you. One moment, please. Okay, we have openings on Wednesday at 10 AM and 1 PM. Which time would you prefer? Let’s go with the 10 AM appointment. Great choice! I’ll book you for Wednesday at 10 AM with Dr. James Rodriguez, our physical therapist. Perfect! I’ve been feeling a bit unsteady lately, so I think this will help. That’s understandable, and that’s exactly what Dr. Rodriguez specializes in. He’ll focus on your mobility and strength. That sounds wonderful. Will I need to do anything before the appointment? Just wear comfortable clothing, and if you have any medical records or a list of your medications, please bring those along. Okay, I can do that. Should I also expect any cost for the session? Yes, the physical therapy session typically ranges from $110 to $140, depending on the specifics of your care. Alright, that sounds reasonable. I’ll confirm with my daughter regarding insurance coverage. That’s a good plan. If you need help with insurance authorization, our Care Coordinator, Lisa Chen, can assist you. Oh, that would be helpful! Can I get her contact number? Of course! You can reach Lisa at +13165559203. She’s available Monday through Saturday. Thank you, Margaret. I really appreciate your help. You’re welcome, Agnes! Is there anything else I can assist you with today? Not at the moment. I’m all set for Wednesday! Fantastic! We look forward to seeing you then. Have a great day! You too, bye! Goodbye!
